restaurant_name: Deezy Dental Home สะพานใหม่ | ทำฟัน จัดฟัน วีเนียร์ รากฟันเทียม
text:
People who come here for dental work really need to have a lot of time. If you don't have a lot of patience, I recommend skipping this place. The appointment system is useless. I had a 12:00 appointment and didn't get to work until 2:30 PM – a 2.5-hour wait.

If you're planning to come here and have other commitments afterward, I recommend allocating a whole day or finding another clinic with a better queuing system. I'm very disappointed. This isn't the first time; I've been here 5 times, and the fastest wait was only 1 hour, and they haven't improved at all.

Walk-ins would be understandable, but this has happened far too many times. If you call to schedule an appointment, the wait shouldn't be this long.
